sloka: इति तेन अनुशिष्टस् तु वाचम् मन्दम् उदीरयत् ।तदा राक्षस शार्दूलम् शार्दूलो भय विह्वलः ॥६-३०-४॥।।
transliteration: iti tena anuśiṣṭas tu vācam mandam udīrayat ।tadā rākṣasa śārdūlam śārdūlo bhaya vihvalaḥ ॥6-30-4॥।।

translations.english: And there after questioned by him (Ravana) Saardula revealed these words overwhelmed by fear, in faint tone to the tiger among Rakshasas.
